---
metadata-files:
  - _cv-metadata.yml
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    anchor-sections: false
    link-external-newwindow: true
    link-external-icon: false
  PrettyPDF-pdf:
    filters:
      - cv-pdf.lua
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{fontawesome5}
        \usepackage{academicons}
        \usepackage{hyperref}
        \usepackage{graphicx}
        \usepackage{xcolor}
        \usepackage{microtype}
        \usepackage{enumitem}
        \setlist[itemize,1]{topsep=3pt,itemsep=2pt,parsep=0pt,partopsep=0pt}
        \setlist[itemize,2]{topsep=0pt,itemsep=0pt,parsep=0pt,partopsep=0pt}
        \setlist[enumerate,1]{topsep=3pt,itemsep=1pt,parsep=0pt,partopsep=0pt}
        \renewcommand{\tightlist}{\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}\setlength{\parsep}{0pt}}
        \setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
format-links: [PrettyPDF-pdf]
other-links:
  - text: PDF (AwesomeCV)
    href: CV_RRS.pdf
    icon: file-pdf
resources:
  - ../assets/cv.css
---
